Flights and lodging were re-checked Oct 29, 2026 for the exact break dates (Feb 13–21 and Mar 20–28, 2027), for a family of four. Flights are Google Flights round-trip fares for 4 including taxes: nonstop from JFK, LGA, EWR or HPN where one exists, otherwise the cheapest same-day connection of 12 hours or less, with cheaper options noted. These are the cheapest fares shown, often basic economy, so fly trips add $320 for one checked bag each. Holiday-week fares move daily and usually climb. Lodging is priced so everyone gets a real bed: one for the parents and one for each teen, with no sofa beds or rollaways. That means a rental with 2+ bedrooms and 3+ beds, or two hotel or resort rooms (or a family suite with 3 real beds). Prices are live Airbnb and Expedia totals for the exact nights at the budget-realistic end (about the 30th percentile), with local tax added, re-checked Oct 31, 2026. Activities, fees and gas come from operator and official sites. All-inclusive resorts (purple pins) were priced Oct 31, 2026 for 8 nights matching the flights (Feb 13–21 or Mar 20–28), for 2 adults plus teens 14 and 16, mostly as live Expedia totals with taxes and fees, in a room that really sleeps 4 (or 2 rooms where the resort requires it). Beaches and Coconut Bay don't sell through Expedia, so those are marked lower-confidence estimates. Fly trips include about $700 to board the dog and $200 for airport parking or rides. Break dates: Feb 13–21 and Mar 20–28, 2027. March break is Holy Week, so Latin American trips are at peak local demand that week.
